text: A new claim shouldn't just sit there -- it needs to land on the right reviewer's desk automatically.
Dmitri builds a Flow Designer flow that triggers the moment a new Warranty Claim record is created.
It looks up the product line from the equipment serial's prefix and assigns the matching reviewer group.
The reviewer group gets notified, the claim moves to Under Review, and an unrecognized code falls back to a general review team.
Next: a Scripted REST API so partners' own field-service software can create and check claims directly.
